result.reason: The operative language gives Client ownership of its content, IP, relevant data, and Support Services work product; includes a present assignment; preserves TrueLink’s ownership of the Interface and embedded TrueLink IP; grants the required perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free licence with modification and sublicensing rights; and excludes joint ownership. The existing broad Credit Data licence remains, but it does not transfer ownership and is outside the ownership-focused rule. The changes are targeted and preserve the original commercial structure. Minor inherited drafting defects remain, including the malformed phrase “means any or its” and duplicate subsection lettering.
